basic.name: Mirror Image
basic.description:
Teleport a short distance in the direction of the mouse cursor, creating 2 Mirror Image in the opposite direction with as much Health as Samuro, each dealing 11~~0.04~~ damage with their Basic Attacks. Whenever an Image takes damage, it deals that amount of damage to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes.

Mirror Images last for 8 seconds, and up to 2 Mirror Images can be active at a time. Each time they or Samuro hit an enemy Hero with their Basic Attack, their duration is extended by 1 second. Using Mirror Image removes most negative effects from Samuro.

basic.name: Critical Strike
basic.description:
Activate to cause Samuro and his Mirror Images next Basic Attack within 8 seconds to be a Critical Strike, dealing 50% additional damage. Stealth is not broken when activated.

Passive: Samuro and his Images also deal a Critical Strike every 4th Basic Attack.

basic.name: Wind Walk
basic.description:
Grant Samuro Stealth for up to 10 seconds or until he attacks, uses an Ability, or takes damage.

While Stealthed, Samuro heals for 2% of his maximum Health every second, his Movement Speed is increased by 20% and he can pass through other units. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Samuro is Unrevealable for the first 1 second of Wind Walk.

heroic.name: Bladestorm
heroic.description: Cause a Bladestorm of destructive force around Samuro for 3 seconds, granting him 25 Armor and dealing 180~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies.

heroic.name: Illusion Master
heroic.description:
Mirror Images can be controlled individually or as a group and their damage is increased by 100%. 

Passive: Image Transmission's cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

trait.name: Image Transmission
trait.description:
Activate to switch places with a target Mirror Image, removing most negative effects from Samuro and all Mirror Images.

Advancing Strikes

Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Samuro's Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds.

activable.name: Select Samuro
activable.description:
Select Samuro

Issue orders to Samuro only.

activable.name: Select All
activable.description:
Select All

Issue orders to Samuro and all Mirror Images.

activable.name: Hearthstone
activable.description: After Channeling for 6 seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring 1125 Health.

level1.name: Way of Illusion
level1.description:
Quest: Every time a Mirror Image Critically Strikes a Hero, Samuro gains 0.25 Attack Damage, up to 10.

Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Samuro gains an additional 30 Attack Damage.

level1.name: Way of the Blade
level1.description:
Critical Strike now happens for Samuro and his Mirror Images every 3rd Basic Attack. 

Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes from Samuro or his Mirror Images reduces their Physical Armor by 5 for 2.25 seconds, up to a maximum reduction of 15 Physical Armor.

level1.name: Way of the Wind
level1.description:
After activating or exiting Wind Walk, Samuro gains 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

Activating Wind Walk instantly heals Samuro for 3% of his maximum Health.

level4.name: Mirage
level4.description: Mirror Image grants Samuro and his Images 40 Spell Armor against the next 2 sources of Spell Damage, reducing their damage by 40%.

level4.name: One With The Wind
level4.description: While Samuro has Wind Walk active and for 3 seconds after breaking it, both he and his Mirror Images gain 25 Armor, taking 25% reduced damage from all sources.

level4.name: Deflection
level4.description: Advancing Strikes grants Samuro and his Mirror Images 35 Physical Armor.

level7.name: Burning Blade
level7.description: Critical Strikes from Samuro or his Mirror Images deal bonus Spell Damage equal to 50% of their Basic Attack damage to the target and other nearby enemies.

level7.name: Phantom Pain
level7.description: Samuro's Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes reduce Image Transmission's cooldown by 1 second, and deal 35% more damage for each active Mirror Image.

level7.name: Crushing Blows
level7.description:
Samuro's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce Critical Strike's cooldown by 2 seconds.

Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes increase Samuro's Basic Attack damage by 10% for 4 seconds, up to 30%.

level10.name: Bladestorm
level10.description: Cause a Bladestorm of destructive force around Samuro for 3 seconds, granting him 25 Armor and dealing 180~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies.

level10.name: Illusion Master
level10.description:
Mirror Images can be controlled individually or as a group and their damage is increased by 100%. 

Passive: Image Transmission's cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

level13.name: Mirrored Steel
level13.description: Samuro's Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Mirror Image by 0.75 seconds.

level13.name: Kawarimi
level13.description: Wind Walk creates a Mirror Image at Samuro's location that will continue whatever he was doing.

level13.name: Shukuchi
level13.description: Wind Walk teleports Samuro a short distance in the direction he's currently facing.

level16.name: Merciless Strikes
level16.description: Samuro's Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemies are always Critical Strikes.

level16.name: Harsh Winds
level16.description: If Wind Walk is broken by Samuro attacking an enemy Hero, he deals 30% additional damage to that target for 3 seconds.

level16.name: Press the Attack
level16.description:
Basic Attacks from Samuro or his Mirror Images against enemy Heroes or while Advancing Strikes is active increases their Attack Speed by 10%, up to 40%.

These bonuses are lost when losing Advancing Strikes.

level20.name: Dance Of Death
level20.description: Mirror Images use Bladestorm when Samuro does, but for 45% damage. If Samuro hits at least 20 enemy Heroes with Bladestorm, then reset its cooldown.

level20.name: Three Blade Style
level20.description: Samuro's Mirror Images only deal half of the damage they take to themselves, effectively increasing their Health by 25%, and their duration is increased to 16 seconds.

level20.name: Wind Strider
level20.description: Wind Walk's cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds.

level20.name: Blademaster’s Pursuit
level20.description: Advancing Strikes grants an additional 15% Movement Speed for Samuro and his Mirror Images, and its duration is increased by 2 seconds.
